en: The postcard is shaped like an artist's palette. It features an illustration of a person dressed as the classic character Pierrot (a clown from French pantomime tradition) holding a stringed instrument, possibly a mandolin, standing next to a simple wooden fence. The figure's outfit is white with pink and blue accents, and the character looks upwards with a wistful expression. At the bottom, there is blue and red hand-written-style text reading 'Bonne Année,' which means 'Happy New Year' in French.
